verses.html: A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.text: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.html: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.text: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.html: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

verses.html: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

verses.html: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.text: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

verses.html: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
verses.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

verses.html: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.text: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.html: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.html: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.text: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.html: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.text: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

verses.html: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.text: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

verses.html: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.html: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.text: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

verses.html: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.text: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.html: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.html: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.html: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.text: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.html: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.text: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.html: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

verses.html: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

verses.html: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
